name: Laurel Furniture & Mattresses

No matter your taste or budget, we have something for everyone. We will work with all our cilents. Our wide selection of merchandise will add style and personality to your all living areas.
about:
Laurel Furniture & Mattresses began operating in 2018 in Laurel, Maryland, establishing itself as a local home goods retailer. The store is situated at 13489 Baltimore Avenue and serves the surrounding community with a range of furniture and mattress options.

The business operates as a brick-and-mortar retail outlet, offering a selection of merchandise for living rooms, bedrooms, and other living areas. The showroom is open seven days a week, with hours Monday through Saturday from 10 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. No manufacturing or fabrication takes place on site; the company sources finished goods from suppliers for resale.

The retailer targets residential customers seeking affordable home furnishings, including families, renters, and homeowners in the Laurel area. Its inventory spans multiple styles and price points, aiming to accommodate varied tastes and budgets.

The founder’s stated goal was to make home styling enjoyable and accessible, emphasizing a combination of attractive design and competitive pricing. The company promotes a “wide selection” as a way to add personality to every room.
